title: "08 · Overlap of the PJT and IAT associations with the SAT block — KHB decomposition (analysis plan v2, 8.8)"
output: html_notebook
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(here); library(tidyverse); library(mice)
source(here("notebooks", "build_vars.R")); source(here("notebooks", "model_helpers.R"))
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## Data
```{r data}
mi       <- read_rds(here("data", "processed", "isrd3_g9_mice.rds"))
imp_list <- complete(mi$imp, "all") |> map(\(d) d |> left_join(mi$miss_flags, by = "caseid") |> prep())
combos   <- expand_grid(outcome = c("off_vers", "serious_any"), block = c("PJT", "IAT"))
```

## Point estimates, KHB in each imputed dataset, averaged
```{r point}
khb_all <- pmap_dfr(combos, \(outcome, block)
  imap_dfr(imp_list, \(d, i) khb_one(d, outcome, block) |> mutate(imp = i)) |>
    mutate(outcome = outcome, block = block))

khb_point <- khb_all |>
  group_by(outcome, block, term) |>
  summarise(across(c(b_total, b_direct, diff, starts_with("via_")), mean), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(pct_overlap = 100 * diff / b_total)
khb_point
```

## Class-level bootstrap (one random imputation per replicate)
```{r boot}
B   <- 1000
set.seed(123)
cls <- unique(imp_list[[1]]$classid)

boot_one <- function(r) {
  d0   <- imp_list[[sample.int(length(imp_list), 1)]]
  draw <- sample(cls, length(cls), replace = TRUE)
  d    <- map2_dfr(draw, seq_along(draw), \(c, k) d0[d0$classid == c, ] |> mutate(classid = paste(c, k)))
  tryCatch(pmap_dfr(combos, \(outcome, block)
             khb_one(d, outcome, block) |> mutate(outcome = outcome, block = block)) |>
             mutate(rep = r),
           error = \(e) NULL)
}
boot <- map_dfr(seq_len(B), boot_one)

khb_ci <- boot |>
  mutate(pct_overlap = 100 * diff / b_total) |>
  group_by(outcome, block, term) |>
  summarise(n_boot = n(),
            diff_lo = quantile(diff, .025), diff_hi = quantile(diff, .975),
            pct_lo  = quantile(pct_overlap, .025), pct_hi = quantile(pct_overlap, .975),
            .groups = "drop")
```

## Output
```{r export}
khb_out <- left_join(khb_point, khb_ci, by = c("outcome", "block", "term")) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 3)))
write_csv(khb_out, here("output", "tables", "khb_v2.csv"))
khb_out
```
